captureMethod: Seven captures retain the original public application UI. The business-scenario figure was refreshed from the current Decision Lab working build through a local preview. All images use native UI and unchanged fictional inputs; no interface text or results were fabricated.
boundary: Fictional teaching inputs, not supplier confirmations or production approval. Prepared shipment source retained the draft-generated appAuthoring metadata. The supplied confirmed case inputs add the resolved current slot record and change the input case label; all other business facts and the local saved case identity stayed fixed. The published rules stayed fixed.
steps: Open original arrival-first app with its direct link.
Collections → Order fulfillment → Adapt app → Create a new app → Create draft.
Retain generated appAuthoring metadata while loading prepared third-option source in Canonical YAML.
Requirements & inputs → Requirements & checks: add SLOT and eight record matches plus five timing comparisons; Preview requirement edit → Apply edit to draft.
Business scenarios → Upload scenarios → Run business scenarios; all 14 passed.
Review commitment → Publish reviewed commitment app → Order fulfillment → Review a first shipment → Add to collection.
Use app; inspect Decision report without confirmation.
Both → Canonical commitment case YAML: apply confirmed inputs; inspect same app and case with valid confirmation.
Copy app link and open in a fresh browser profile; confirm automatic collection creation and unchanged missing-confirmation starter.
Resume original saved arrival case and export it to verify original source release and two-option model.
